page.overview:
Who is Unopan?

The Unopans are a race of aliens that were native to the planet Unopa until its destruction by the Viltrum Empire.

The Unopans are a humanoid species, with three fingers on each hand and two large toes on their feet. Their skin is orange and heads are conical shaped and dominated by a single eye and lack any kind of nose.

At some point before the events of the series, the Viltrum Empire who, in their aim to expand their empire, attacked the Unopan's homeworld of Unopa. This led to the Viltrumites destroying the planet when the Unopan's rebelled against them.

With their planet destroyed, the Unopans were forced to create breeding camps to prevent their species' extinction.
